goal: Publish one shared semantic icon system so every visible feature and amenity on VII detail pages has an appropriate, centered vector icon.

intent_model.literal_request: Provide an icon for every feature, verify correctness and publish.
intent_model.implied_outcome: The complete detail-page family looks intentional rather than partly illustrated and partly generic.
likely_rejections: Generic checks remain for common features
A new API feature has no visual fallback
The icon is present but visually off-center
The local fix was not verified after publication

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Cover all detail-page worlds and unknown future labels through one shared resolver.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: The family inventory and fallback checks are mandatory.

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Publication is authorized only after pre-release gates pass, followed by live checks on the exact version.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: Local build alone cannot satisfy the request.

cognitive_flow.current_layer: Each feature label is paired with one immediately recognizable visual anchor.
cognitive_flow.current_decision: No user decision is added; the icon improves scanning of existing information.
cognitive_flow.next_action: The visitor continues reading or uses the existing detail-page action.
deferred_complexity: The internal keyword classification and supplier-specific values remain invisible to visitors.
preserved_depth: Full feature groups, room details, expandable lists and localized labels remain available.

natural_destination: Public VII vacation, event, spa and hourly detail pages

facts.claim: The current vacation resolver recognizes only a small set of phrases and uses a generic check fallback.
Event details use a generic check, hourly amenities use one generic symbol, and spa facilities render text-only list items.
The existing shared SVG centering rule is an approved VII requirement.

assumptions.claim: A semantic vector icon, rather than a photographic image, is the intended visual for a textual feature.
assumptions.validation: The approved current component and feedback standard use centered SVG icons for features.

in_scope: Shared semantic feature classifier and icon component
Vacation highlights, grouped features, rooms and sleeping amenities
out_of_scope: Redesigning feature layouts or page hierarchy
Changing search filters, URLs or booking behavior
invariants: Feature text and grouping remain unchanged
Existing page order, booking, gallery, contact, breadcrumbs and navigation remain unchanged
Icons remain decorative and hidden from assistive technology because the adjacent text carries the meaning
Heebo typography and current RTL/LTR behavior remain unchanged
No feature is invented when supplier data is absent

requirements.statement: Every rendered feature or amenity has one visible vector icon.
Common labels use a semantically appropriate icon and unknown labels use a non-empty fallback.
requirements.source: User request and VII product standard

requirements.statement: The behavior is shared across vacation, events, spa and hourly detail pages without changing their content or flows.
The exact release is built, tested, published and verified on desktop and mobile.

acceptance_checks.setup: Representative detail pages in all four worlds
acceptance_checks.action: Inspect each visible feature and amenity row
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Each row contains exactly one non-empty centered SVG wrapper next to its unchanged label.

acceptance_checks.setup: Known labels including bedrooms, storage, guests, pool, kitchen, parking, accessibility, Wi-Fi, sauna, barbecue and TV
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Each maps to the intended semantic category and no Hebrew plural is mistaken for sea or view.

acceptance_checks.setup: A non-empty label unknown to the classifier
acceptance_checks.observable_result: A neutral circle-check icon is rendered; the wrapper is not empty and the label remains visible.

acceptance_checks.setup: A label contains punctuation, mixed language or a supplier phrase that matches no known semantic rule
acceptance_checks.action: Render the feature without a preferred icon
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The shared component renders the neutral fallback icon without throwing, hiding the label or producing an empty SVG.

acceptance_checks.setup: Production candidate at desktop and 390-pixel mobile widths
acceptance_checks.action: Inspect vacation, event, spa and hourly feature sections
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Icons are centered, labels do not overlap, and no horizontal overflow or missing icon appears.

acceptance_checks.setup: Published release and recorded previous version
acceptance_checks.action: Verify representative unchanged flows and rollback identity
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Galleries, booking, contacts, breadcrumbs and feature expansion remain functional and the previous version can be restored.

authorization_boundary: Implementation, testing and production publication are authorized; unrelated data, DNS, payment and supplier mutations are excluded.
